items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 29 at 1:59AM PDT until September 30 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding expected due to the combination
of high tides and elevated surf.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM PDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and minor coastal erosion
expected during high tides. Additionally, elevated surf will
lead to strong rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Elevated surf of 2-4 feet with local sets
to 5 feet on south-facing beaches. Morning high tides are
expected to peak between 6.8 and 7.1 feet during the late
mornings between 10 AM and noon through Wednesday. These tide
predictions have been corrected to reflect current trends in
observed tide observations.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
